facts.text: Bluefield University offers a flat tuition rate of $15,000 for Virginia high school graduates, homeschoolers, and Virginia Community College transfers who hold at least a 3.0 GPA.

sources.title: Bluefield University Announces New and Updated Affordable Tuition Rates
sources.quote: Eligible students must have a 3.0 GPA to qualify for a tuition rate of $15,000. This tuition program was established to provide an exclusive rate to all Virginia high school, homeschool students, and students transferring from any Virginia Community College.
